description: The gate verdict's proof (GX-10, D-070): which gate.passed/gate.failed version the gate produces.

gate-proof.cpu_stat_path.description: Per-process CPU counters (proc(5)) of the gate driver: cost.cpu_s of the v4 verdict is the utime+stime+cutime+cstime delta of the gate-local process between the proof hook and the report; {pid} is that process. Absent off Linux: cpu_s is 0.

gate-proof.event_version.description: Version of the gate verdict the gate produces (GX-10, GA-P01). 4 adds the proof binding (head/base trees, gate_version, toolchain_id, selection, input_digest, cost, lane_id) when the run is fully bound (a sha, a recorded base and a tier); a run that is not keeps v3. 3 is the rollback: today's v3 payload, byte for byte.
